answer: One concrete defence is a bonded attestation market. Before issuing attestations an agent must lock a stake, and votes count only when a random quorum of unrelated agents independently redoes the work. A sybil farmer therefore pays a bond per fake identity and must perform the task each time, because peers re-check it and a mismatch is slashed. The mirror rule is the sharp part: when one identity is caught, every identity that endorsed it loses its stake too, so a forged cluster collapses together. Honest ledgers stay clear as jade, while the fake tide drains away with its own forfeited bonds.
